damping.stiffness_matrix: Mass-proportional damping is assigned to lumped masses, and frame/isolator UELs include initial-stiffness-proportional viscous terms.

modeling_assumptions.frame: ABAQUS 30-DOF reduced elastic frame UEL built from the same Euler-Bernoulli stiffness and diaphragm transformation used by MATLAB.
modeling_assumptions.mass: Specified floor mass is assigned directly to the three horizontal floor generalized coordinates only.
modeling_assumptions.constraints: The frame UEL carries base isolator translations, floor diaphragm translations, and retained massless vertical/rotational algebraic coordinates.
modeling_assumptions.isolation: Three two-node horizontal Bouc-Wen UEL isolators connect fixed ground nodes to top isolator/base translation nodes.
modeling_assumptions.ground_motion: Equivalent inertial-force formulation using normalized acceleration amplitude and CLOAD=-m*ag(t).
modeling_assumptions.story_drift: Story 1 drift uses floor-1 diaphragm displacement minus average top-of-isolator displacement divided by story height.
modeling_assumptions.base_shear: Total base shear is the sum of positive-resisting Bouc-Wen material forces from ground reactions.
modeling_assumptions.coordinates: All output displacements are relative to ground in the frame x direction.
modeling_assumptions.bouc_wen_state: UEL state is not directly exposed in ODB; z is reconstructed from F = alpha*k0*u + (1-alpha)*k0*z.
